description.en: Whether to enable scheduled starts. Valid values: `0` (disabled) and `1` (enabled).
Whether to enable scheduled stops. Valid values: `0` (disabled) and `1` (enabled).
The end of the time range to query. The time must be in the `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` format.

description.zh: 需要取出的数据条数；大于0，最大不能超过100，默认10
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.

description.zh: 任务名称；需进行UTF-8格式的URLEncode编码
description.en: The task name. The value must be URL-encoded in UTF-8.

description.zh: 从第几条开始获取；大于等于0，默认0
description.en: The pagination offset. The value must be greater than or equal to 0. Default value: 0.
The beginning of the time range to query. The time must be in the `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` format.

description.zh: 任务状态；0.初始 1.运行中 2.暂停 3.结束
description.en: The task status. Valid values: `0` (Initial), `1` (Running), `2` (Paused), and `3` (Finished).

description.zh: 时间过滤条件；1.任务启动时间 2.任务结束时间 3.任务创建时间
description.en: The time filter to apply. Valid values: `1` (task start time), `2` (task end time), and `3` (task creation time).

description.zh: 任务类型；1：预测外呼任务，2：自动外呼任务
description.en: The task type. Valid values: `1` (predictive outbound task) and `2` (automated outbound task).
